title: Law to expand discounted park fees to veterans and military families
summary: This bill would require the Parks Department to charge reduced admission and membership fees at all recreational facilities, including recreation centers, museums, zoos and botanical gardens, to seniors 62 and older, young adults ages 18 to 24, people with disabilities, active military members and veterans and their minor children. Reduced fees could be no more than 25 percent of the highest fee charged at that facility. It would take effect 180 days after becoming law.
